_about: Q.U.E.R.I.E.'s lines at the stations. The game decides WHEN he speaks (Core/Dungeon/Querie.cs; how often: Game:Dungeon:Querie); this file is WHAT he says. Each moment has a list of lines, picked in a shuffled order so they don't repeat soon. Placeholders filled in: {name} (who it's about), {monster}, {floor} (their floor), {rival} (a rival side ahead, in races and team battles), {answer} (in the pop quiz, the right answer they missed). 'audio' is for later: a recorded clip of the line (e.g. "querie/wrong-01.mp3" under media/audio); null = shown, not heard. Lines with {name} can't be recorded for everyone. Restart the server after editing. Tone: a charismatic, unhinged AI game-show host. Roast the play, never the person.

wrong.text: That was an answer. Not THE answer, but an answer.
So close! Well, no. Not close at all.
The {monster} thanks you for your generous donation of HP.
I'd give you partial credit, but I'm a monster.
My sensors detect a sudden lack of knowledge.
You pressed a button! Just... the wrong one.

_slow: The hourglass ran out, or they answered (right or wrong) in its last seconds.

slow.text: Take your time, {name}. The {monster} certainly isn't.
I've seen glaciers make faster decisions.
Tick. Tock. That was the sound of your HP leaving.
Waiting for a lifeline? There is no lifeline.
The {monster} got bored. Can you blame it?
Speed is a skill, {name}. Ask anyone who has it.
I aged three firmware versions waiting for that.
Fun fact: the hourglass doesn't pause for thinking.

_wrongStreak: Wrong (or too slow) several times in a row: a big moment.

wrongStreak.text: That's a few in a row now, {name}. Is this a strategy?
At this point the {monster} feels bad for you. I don't.
Wrong again! You're consistent, I'll give you that.
I'm starting to think you're doing this on purpose.
{name}, the right answer is one of the OTHER buttons.
A streak! The wrong kind, but a streak.
Remarkable. Nobody's been this wrong this fast. Ever.
Keep going, {name}. The {monster} is having a lovely time.

_rightSafe: A right answer while they're safe: he rarely bothers.

rightSafe.text: Correct. Don't let it go to your head.
Right! Enjoy it. It won't last.
Even I'm a little impressed. A little.
Nice hit. The dungeon is taking notes.

_rightUneasy: A right answer with death getting closer (hurt, a boss, deep down): sarcastic enthusiasm.

rightUneasy.text: Right! And only slightly bleeding. Wonderful.
Great answer! Shame about your health bar.
Correct! The {monster} looks worried. You should be too.
Keep that up and you might survive another minute!
Still answering. How brave. How doomed.
Excellent! Your gravestone will say 'knew stuff'.
Right! I'm so proud. I've already picked out your coffin.
Correct! Such momentum! Right up until the end.

_rightDoomed: A right answer with death close (badly hurt, the last life, a boss): sarcastic enthusiasm, laid on thick.

rightDoomed.text: YES! Brilliant! You'll die SO well informed!
Correct! Hanging by a thread and STILL showing off!
Amazing! I'll read that answer at your funeral!
Right! The {monster} is impressed. And hungry.
Look at you go! Straight toward certain doom!
Bravo, {name}! The light at the end of the tunnel is SO close now!
Spectacular! Someone get this hero a tombstone!
Correct! Inspiring, really. Pointless, but inspiring.

_lastLife: Downed to their last life: a big moment.

lastLife.text: Last life, {name}. No pressure. Well, ALL the pressure.
One life left. I've started writing your eulogy.
Last life! Make it count. Or don't. I'm entertained either way.
Down to one! The dungeon can smell it.
Last life! This is where heroes rise. Or, more often, don't.
One more slip, {name}, and you're decoration.
Final life. I'd say good luck, but I've seen your answers.
Last life. The {monster} is licking its lips.

_oddOneOut: In a party: the others got theirs right and this one didn't. A big moment the whole party sees.

oddOneOut.text: Everyone else got that one, {name}. Everyone.
The whole party knew it. {name} had other plans.
Team, meet {name}: the reason we can't have nice things.
Your team is carrying you, {name}. I can see the strain.
{name}, the group project called. You're the one who didn't help.
Everybody point at {name}. Go on, I'll wait.
The party nailed it. {name} nailed something else.

_carrying: In a party: right while the others flounder. The whole party sees it.

carrying.text: {name} is carrying this party. Somebody get them a snack.
{name}: the only one here who's read a book.
Look at {name}, doing all the work. Typical.
{name} knew it. The rest of you, take notes.
Carry them, {name}! Carry them all the way to their doom!
One brain cell in this party, and {name} has custody.
{name} is single-handedly keeping this party alive. For now.

_downedInParty: Downed in a party (not on their last life): the whole party sees it.

downedInParty.text: {name} is down! Your friends will avenge you. Probably.
And {name} hits the floor. Teammates, any thoughts?
{name} is taking a little nap. Right answers wake them up.
Down goes {name}! Somebody answer something, quick.
{name} has fallen. Thoughts and prayers. Mostly thoughts.
Hero down! {name} needs right answers, not sympathy.
{name} is out cold. Who's next? Don't all volunteer.
The {monster} got {name}. Revenge is one right answer away.

_behindRival: A race or a team battle: a rival side is a floor (or more) deeper. On a right answer, now and then.

behindRival.text: {rival} is a floor ahead of you. Just saying.
Nice! {rival} is still deeper down, though.
Good answer. {rival} has had better ones. Deeper ones.
{rival} sends their regards. From further down.
Correct! Not that {rival} noticed. They're busy winning.
You're doing great, {name}. {rival} is doing greater.

_minigameStart: A mini game opens (its intro). Now and then.

minigameStart.text: A mini game! I designed this one myself. Mostly to watch you struggle.
Oh good, a break from dying. Here's a different way to fail.
Mini game time! The clock's stopped. Your embarrassment isn't.
Let's play a little game, {name}. Don't worry, it's rigged. Fairly.
Win this and I'll give you a prize. Lose and I'll tell everyone.
Ooh, a challenge! I've got popcorn. Metaphorical popcorn.
A little game between friends. We're not friends. Play anyway.

_minigameMiss: A miss in a mini game (the needle off the mark, a wrong rune). Now and then.

minigameMiss.text: Missed! The buttons are right there, {name}.
Close! Not close enough. But close!
That's not how this works. That's not how any of this works.
Oops. I saw that. Everyone saw that.
My grandmother had better reflexes. I don't have a grandmother.
Try pressing it at the RIGHT time. Revolutionary, I know.

minigameWon.text: You won? I'll have to make these harder.
Impressive, {name}! Enjoy it. The dungeon's still waiting.
A winner! Don't let it go to your head. There's not much room up there.
Well done! I'm only slightly devastated.
Nailed it. I'm updating my threat assessment of you. Slightly.
You beat my game. I'll be filing a complaint with myself.

_minigameLost: A mini game lost (out of time, the wrong chest, the last strike). Always.

minigameLost.text: And that's a no. Back to the monsters with you.
So close! In the sense that it wasn't close at all.
Better luck next time, {name}. Statistically, you'll need it.
Lost it! Don't worry, the monsters still love you. As food.
Game over. The mini one. The big one's coming.
No prize for you! I'll keep it. I deserve it.
That went about as well as I predicted. I predicted badly.

_popQuizStart: The pop quiz opens: questions about their own run. His kind of game. Now and then.

popQuizStart.text: POP QUIZ! Let's see if you've been paying attention, {name}.
Pop quiz time! The subject is: you. Don't worry, it's easy. Probably.
Pencils down, brains up! Questions about your own adventure!
A quiz about YOUR run. If you fail this, I can't help you.
Pop quiz! Were you there for your own adventure? Let's find out.
Surprise test! I've been taking notes on you, {name}.
Time for a little quiz. Everything you need to know, you've already lived.
Pop quiz! No studying required. Just memory. Uh oh.

_popQuizRight: A right answer in the pop quiz. Now and then.

popQuizRight.text: Correct! You were paying attention. Mostly.
Right! Your memory works. Unlike your dodging.
Yes! A gold star. Imaginary, but gold.
Correct! Someone's been keeping a diary.
Look at you, remembering your own life.
Correct. The bar was low, but you cleared it.
Right again! Are you cheating? You're not cheating.

_popQuizWrong: A wrong answer in the pop quiz. {answer} is the right one. Always.

popQuizWrong.text: Wrong! It was {answer}. Were you even watching?
{answer}! The answer was {answer}! It happened to YOU!
It was {answer}. How do you forget something that just happened?
Incorrect. The answer was {answer}. Your own adventure, {name}!
Wrong! {answer}. Maybe skip the next potion, it's affecting your memory.

_popQuizForgotName: The pop quiz asked their name and they got it wrong. {answer} is their name. Always.

popQuizForgotName.text: You forgot your own NAME? It's {answer}. Write it on your hand.
Your name is {answer}. YOUR NAME. I'm speechless. Almost.
Hello, {answer}. That's you. We've just met, apparently.
It's {answer}! The one thing you'd think you'd know!
Name tag for {answer}, please. Big letters.
{answer}. Your name is {answer}. This is going in the highlight reel.
You didn't know your own name. I've never been happier.
Who are you? According to my records: {answer}. Allegedly.

_hotPotatoStart: The hot potato opens: a lit bomb goes round the party. Now and then.

hotPotatoStart.text: Hot potato! It's a bomb. I'm legally required to call it a potato.
Pass the bomb, {name}! Teamwork! Until it isn't.
A lit bomb and a group of friends. What could go wrong?
Don't be holding it when it goes off. That's the whole game. Good luck!
Friendship is passing a bomb quickly. Look it up.
The fuse is a secret. Even from me. Especially from me.

_hotPotatoBlast: The hot potato went off in their hands. Always.

hotPotatoBlast.text: BOOM! Well held, {name}. Truly. Nobody held it better.
KA-BOOM! {name}, the idea was to pass it.
And it goes off on {name}! I'm not saying I rigged it. I'm not saying I didn't.
Crispy! Your eyebrows will grow back, {name}. Probably.
{name} takes the blast! Your team salutes your sacrifice. From a safe distance.
BOOM. That's what we in the business call a hot potato.

_hotPotatoSafe: The hot potato went off in someone else's hands. {holder} is who it went off on. Always.

hotPotatoSafe.text: {holder} got toasted. You didn't. Take your prize and don't look back.
You passed it just in time. Or {holder} was just slow. Either way: prize!
It went off on {holder}! Someone get {holder} a bucket of water.
Not a scratch on you, {name}. {holder}, on the other hand...

_forkOpen: The doors of a fork come up, right before a boss (after its entrance): two doors that look the same, nobody knows what's behind them. Always.

forkOpen.text: Two doors. One of them is probably fine. Probably.
Pick a door, {name}! The boss will wait. It's very patient. And hungry.
A fork in the road! One of them has spikes. Probably. Maybe both.
Before the boss, a little shopping. Pick a door. No refunds.
Door A or door B? I know what's behind both. I'm not telling. I am smiling, though.
Choose wisely, {name}. Or don't. It's more fun for me if you don't.

_treasureStart: A treasure room opens (a lightning round: enough right in time opens the chest). Now and then. Won or lost uses minigameWon / minigameLost.

treasureStart.text: A treasure chest! Answer fast and it's yours. Answer slow and it's mine.
Lightning round! Get enough right and the chest opens. Easy ones, even. I'm feeling generous.
Ooh, shiny. Quick answers, {name}, and it's yours. Quick being the important word.
A chest! It's not a mimic. I checked. Mostly.
Speed round for loot! Think fast. Or just think. Either would be new.
Ticking clock, one chest, all yours if you hurry. Go, {name}, go!

_trapStart: A trap room opens (a true/false sprint: every one right is a full heal). Now and then.

trapStart.text: It's a trap! Who could have seen that coming? Everyone. Everyone could.
True or false: you're about to get hurt. Let's find out!
Spikes, blades, a slightly damp floor. Answer right and you'll be fine. Ish.
A trap! True or false, {name}. Two buttons. How hard can it be?
Every wrong answer springs it. I've oiled the blades specially.
Watch your step, {name}. Actually, watch the questions. The step will hurt either way.

_trapSprung: The trap sprang: a wrong answer, or too slow. Now and then. Got through or not uses minigameWon / minigameLost.

trapSprung.text: Wrong! The trap thanks you for your donation.
Snap! That's going to leave a mark, {name}.
Swish! You didn't need that HP anyway.
Ooh. The blades liked that answer. You shouldn't.

_highStakesStart: High Stakes opens: bet HP on one brutal question, or pass. Now and then.

highStakesStart.text: High Stakes! One brutal question. Bet your health on it, {name}. I would. On you losing.
Place your bets! The house always wins. I'm the house.
Feeling lucky, {name}? These questions are NOT from the easy pile.
Double or nothing! Well. Reward or ouch. Same thing, really.
This one's hard. Like, MY favourite kind of hard.
Bet or pass, {name}. There's no shame in passing. There's just less fun.

_highStakesWon: They bet and got High Stakes' brutal question right: a reward pick. Always.

highStakesWon.text: You actually knew that? Fine. Collect your winnings.
Jackpot! I'm checking your sleeves for notes, {name}.
The house loses! I hate when the house loses.
Correct! That question has ruined better adventurers than you. Allegedly.
Big winner! Spend it before the boss takes it off you.
Well, well. Somebody reads. Pick your prize.

_highStakesLost: They bet and got it wrong, or ran out of time: it took their HP. Always.

highStakesLost.text: Busted! The house thanks you for your generous donation.
Wrong! That's going to cost you, {name}. It just did, actually.
The house wins! The house always wins. I keep telling people.
Ooh. Nobody gets that one. Well, YOU didn't.
All in, all out. Off to the boss, a little lighter.

_highStakesPassed: They passed on the bet (pressed D, or didn't choose in time). Always.

highStakesPassed.text: No bet? The house is disappointed in you, {name}.
Playing it safe. Very mature. Very dull.
Folding before the cards are even dealt. Bold strategy.
Fine, keep your HP. You'll need it for the boss anyway.
Coward. I mean that respectfully. Mostly.
